hypothesis: All comparable metrics agree within a disclosed 1e-6 rounding tolerance (the product publishes stability_jaccard_min rounded to 6 decimals). Re-derivation from the 7 committed legs yields answer_ready_rate 6/7 = 0.8571428571428571, citation_validity 1.0, prose_citation_validity 1.0, source_validity 1.0, language_match_rate 1.0, degradation_visible_rate 1.0, n_degraded_legs 1, stability_jaccard_min 0.6666666666666666 (product 0.666667), n_prose_markers 56, n_prose_markers_resolved 56. The one degraded leg is rent-default|baseline|it|r1 with degradation_code e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT, which is exactly the leg the product lists under legs_without_prose_markers. product_claim_reliable_live_answer is false because answer_ready_rate != 1.0, so the product correctly withholds the reliability claim. posture_unchanged fields are all false. Every leg's text_sha256 re-hashes from its recorded text. Counter-row totals recompute as n_counter_rows=0 confirmed on all 7 legs while n_counter_rows_emitted sums to 30 — published together so the confirmed-versus-emitted distinction is never collapsed.
baseline: The product-owned measurement of record at /tmp/lex_accepted/product/results/product/answer_reliability/39799042649_measurement.json (sha256 b41d25fc04583b2c4fa330d70a1547dd22c6fe77e8814f07030099a7b9606ec7) and its frozen protocol at 39799042649_protocol_freeze.json (sha256 fd3fc30dba6f1161c9c0968032a0c9cff8c386dd14b5a6072773c8dfc1e3dd5f), both reachable from accepted product head fe219a19.
metric: A side-by-side row per frozen quantity: product-published value, lane-recomputed value from the committed legs, match boolean (with disclosed 1e-6 rounding tolerance only for float metrics the product itself rounds), comparability note. Row count and divergence list are both published; a quantity that cannot be compared is reported NOT_COMPARABLE, never silently dropped.
success_rule: EXIT 0 (cross-check complete, zero divergence on comparable quantities) only if (i) the measurement and protocol pins hold, (ii) every quantity in quantities_compared is emitted as a row, (iii) every comparable quantity matches within its stated tolerance, (iv) product_claim_reliable_live_answer is honest (false given answer_ready_rate < 1.0, true would be dishonest), and (v) every deliberately planted divergence is detected by the non-vacuity controls. Exit 1 = a comparable quantity diverges OR a control fails (instrument vacuous or product dishonest). Exit 2 = environment/identity mismatch (never a product verdict). A completed cross-check is NOT a claim that any frozen absolute bar is met, NOT a serve recommendation, NOT a jurist-usefulness claim and NOT an owner question.
controls: C1_planted_metric_divergence: flip one leg's citations.all_valid to false; the re-derived citation_validity must fall below the published 1.0 and the match row must fail.
C2_planted_claim_flip: force product_claim_reliable_live_answer=true while answer_ready_rate stays 0.857; the honesty gate must fail.
C3_planted_ready_rate_inflation: mark the degraded it leg answer.status=ready; the re-derived answer_ready_rate becomes 1.0 and the match against the published 0.857 must fail.
C4_planted_leg_drop: remove one leg from the population; the population gates must fail.
C5_planted_text_sha_drift: mutate one leg's text without updating text_sha256; the integrity gate must fail.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: whether the product's live-answer reliability measurement of record is internally re-derivable from its own committed legs and whether its reliability-claim boolean is honest. It does NOT re-run the live path (zero network), does NOT score any frozen LABEL/GEOMETRY rubric, does NOT lift any DO-NOT-SERVE order, does NOT certify admission, and does NOT claim the map helps a jurist. human_gate_ready, machine_gate_ready, packet_admitted, ready_for_owner_session and owner_decision_required stay false. It runs no obsolete universal-174k benchmark.
